tasks.prompt: Repair parse_record(record). Input is one valid CSV record without embedded newlines, using comma delimiters, double-quote quoting and doubled double-quotes as escapes. Return its fields as strings, preserving whitespace and empty fields; an empty record returns []. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair backoff_delays(retries, initial, cap). Produce exactly retries exponential delays: the first is min(initial, cap), each subsequent uncapped delay doubles. Every delay is capped at cap. retries is an integer and initial/cap are numeric. Reject negative retries and nonpositive initial/cap with ValueError; zero retries returns []. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair TTLCache expiry. put(key, value, ttl, now) replaces an entry and expires it at now + ttl. get(key, now, default=None) returns the value only while now is strictly before expiry; expired entries are removed, missing entries return default. A zero TTL expires immediately. Negative TTL raises ValueError without replacing an existing entry. Preserve falsey values. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair walk_leaves(value, path=()). Traverse nested dicts and lists depth-first in their existing order, returning a list of (full_path_tuple, scalar) pairs. Dict keys and integer list indexes extend the current path; scalars include None and falsey values. Empty containers produce no leaves. Honor an optional initial path and do not modify input. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair date_range(start, end, step_days=1) for datetime.date inputs within ordinary calendar ranges. Return dates from start in positive integer step_days increments, including end if a step lands on it. Equal endpoints return [start]; start after end returns []. Reject zero or negative step_days with ValueError. Handle month/year boundaries and leap days. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair merge_config(base, overrides). Recursively merge values only when both are dictionaries, retaining base-only keys. All other override values, including lists, None and falsey values, replace the base value. Return an independent deep copy: neither calling the function nor mutating the result may change either input. Inputs are acyclic standard Python containers. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair filter_logs(records, minimum). Levels increase in severity as debug, info, warning, error, critical. Keep records at or above minimum, including equality, preserving input order and record contents without mutating input. records may be a one-pass iterable of dictionaries containing level. Unknown minimum or record levels raise ValueError. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair dependency_order(graph), where graph maps node strings to ordered lists of dependency strings. Use depth-first traversal in dictionary insertion order and each dependency list order, appending a node after its dependencies. Include dependency-only nodes, emit each node once, and reject all cycles (including self cycles) with ValueError. Do not modify graph. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.
